==Ingredients==

* 2 boneless [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] breasts
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Paprika|paprika]]
* 4 tablespoons [[Cookbook:Half and Half|half and half]]
* 1 tablespoon [[Cookbook:Lemon Juice|lemon juice]]
* 3 slices of Provel (a brand of processed cheese product) or Muenster

==Procedure==

#Combine all ingredients in a [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|baking dish]].
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] at 400°F (205°C) until internal temperature of the chicken breasts reaches 165°F (74°C).
